comments.author: Egw
comments.body:
I just made a very interesting observation. If you click on a company administration officer in any major city, there's a "production" option. Under it, a number of useful recipes can be found, for all production skills. The custom cannon/carronade(14) ones are among them, which means you can produce the memo album maestro guns in any major city. No real need to bother about central capital status, investment or a trip to carib at all - for this particular task. The produced maestros happily go to the memo album (confirmed with my company mate).

I don't know if that's old news, but I just noticed it today. The production option has been there for at least a few months and the relevant recipes look stable (they don't change e.g. monthly or weekly). At least the storage and handi ones that I had seen in the past have been there for around four months at least.

It could be a company perk, or a world clock thing, but it's worth checking if you or a friend are after this casting memo album.

comments.author: Guilder
comments.body: Good eye. It's a relatively new company perk that popped in some patches ago; even if you're a one-member company with no contributions whatsoever, those recipes show up at any Company Administration Office in the game. IIRC, Caribbean MA Sail recipes also show up there.
